status.en: 11 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 22% more than the week before, most of them in Damascus, Quneitra and Golan Heights.
status.nb: 11 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 22 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Damaskus, Quneitra og Golanhøydene.

summary.en: ISIL has continued to target Syrian security forces, killing two internal security members in a suicide attack in Hasakah and injuring several others, while another suicide bombing in Tartous wounded a security officer and killed a gunman. The Syrian government is considering a law to grant nationality to children of foreign fighters, reflecting concerns about the legacy of extremist participation. Qatar, Saudi Arabia and Jordan have issued condemnations of attacks on Syrian security facilities, indicating regional diplomatic responses. Syrian authorities seized Iranian weapons destined for Lebanon, showing ongoing arms interdiction efforts. 2,732 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: ISIL har fortsatt å angripe syriske sikkerhetsstyrker, og drepte to medlemmer av den interne sikkerheten i et selvmordsangrep i Hasakah og såret flere andre, mens et annet selvmordsbombeangrep i Tartous såret en sikkerhetsoffiser og drepte en bevæpnet mann. Den syriske regjeringen vurderer en lov som skal gi statsborgerskap til barn av utenlandske krigere, noe som gjenspeiler bekymringer om arven etter ekstremistisk deltakelse. Qatar, Saudi-Arabia og Jordan har kommet med fordømmelser av angrep på syriske sikkerhetsanlegg, noe som viser regionale diplomatiske reaksjoner. Syriske myndigheter beslagla iranske våpen som var på vei til Libanon, noe som viser pågående innsats for å hindre våpenoverføringer. 2 732 dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Aftermath of the Syrian civil war
background.extract: Disputes and clashes in Syria have continued following the fall of the Assad regime in December 2024, which many sources consider the end of the Syrian civil war. Numerous actors are involved, including clashes between the newly-formed Syrian caretaker government and later the Syrian transitional government led by the former emir of Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) and incumbent president Ahmed al-Sharaa, Assad loyalists, Alawite groups, and Druze insurgents; clashes between elements of the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army (SNA) and the government on one side, and formerly the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) on the other; as well as an Israeli invasion and occupation of the demilitarized buffer zone in southwestern Syria.
